conventions.reference: coherent-state QED-RHF (photon in vacuum after the coherent shift)
conventions.dse: included: 1/2 (lambda.(d - <d>))^2 with the quadrupole one-electron term
conventions.coupling: lambda vector in a.u.; omega does not enter the mean-field energy
conventions.photons: none beyond the coherent state (mean field)

notes: QED-HF only; omega is not an input of cqed_rhf (the coherent-state mean-field energy is omega-independent).
